verdict.rationale: GitHub explicitly documents an opt-out for individual subscribers ('Individual subscribers can opt out of having their data used for AI model training at any time'), directly satisfying the story's core ask. However, community commentary raises unresolved skepticism about enterprise-level guarantees ('Can these enterprises really make sure that their code won't be used to train Copilot? I am skeptical'), and there's no detail on default settings, organization-level controls, or verification mechanisms. Missing for 10: independent verification that opt-out is honored, clarity on business/enterprise tier defaults and controls, and technical detail on how opt-out is enforced.
